name: Dig it nation Day Event
description:
This farm has been within the family for over 200 years without anyone to their knowledge ever detecting it. £20 Per-person Under 14's Free. NO DOGS
To begin it will be 80 spaces and on a first come first served basis. Will Sell out.
Spoil mats are a must... if you dont have one then a carrier bag will do
Hillforts, a beautiful Gentry manor house, ancient oak trees, shooters lodges, natural springs, blooming gardens and if thats not enough you can even make out the ridge of the old roman road that dominates the surrounding land from a ridge and we sit comfortably within viewing distance of the nearby hill fort.
